ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation bands along the trailing edges and terminal tips; discrete dark mottling clusters (blobs) distributed on the light medial surfaces, predominantly on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with visible peaks along the trailing edge of the right lobe; the left lobe trailing edge displays similar jagged topography but is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves along the visible leading edges of both lobes as they emerge from the water line, tapering toward acute terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters on the light ventral surface of the right lobe; no high-contrast white rosette clusters are resolvable.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) is visible on the distal region of the right lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe proximal to the tip, distinct from standard serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water cavitation and spray obscure the central fluke region and the connection to the caudal peduncle.
